_note: Prefixes and suffixes. Each is a bundle of phase-tagged effects. The first three are ports of the original sera affixes to prove backward compatibility.

affixes.name: Petty
affixes.description: Hits harder when they haven't suffered yet.

affixes.name: of Silence
affixes.description: Shut up. Double damage to anything mid-cast.

affixes.name: of Ice
affixes.description: Permanent material state. A sheen that never melts.

effects.name: iced material
effects.tell: Frost beads along the edge and does not run off.

affixes.name: Consecrated
affixes.description: Blessed metal. Threatens what steel cannot.

effects.name: consecration
effects.tell: The blade throws a light that casts no shadow.

affixes.name: of the Unseen Step
affixes.description: You cannot be chosen as a target while it holds.

effects.name: untargetable
effects.tell: Attention slides off the wearer like water off glass.

affixes.name: Keen
affixes.description: Balanced and honed for a decisive first opening.

affixes.name: Ironroot
affixes.description: Dense metal that carries the weight of old stone.

affixes.name: of Embers
affixes.description: Warm sparks crawl across the surface without consuming it.

effects.name: ember material
effects.tell: Tiny coals pulse along the edge.

affixes.name: of the Watcher
affixes.description: It notices movement before its bearer does.

effects.name: watcher tell
effects.tell: The surface turns toward the nearest motion.
